title: #306 Choice of Transportation
prompt: Choose one transportation vehicle and explain why you think it has changed people’s lives.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car gives people space to travel.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The car gives people space to travel.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Trains help people get better education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Trains help people get better education.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car provides people with freedom and improved personal mobility, allowing them to visit previously hard-to-reach places.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The car provides people with freedom and improved personal mobility, allowing them to visit previously hard-to-reach places.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars facilitate the development of cities by enabling people to commute long distances, allowing them to live in quieter suburbs while working in the city.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars facilitate the development of cities by enabling people to commute long distances, allowing them to live in quieter suburbs while working in the city.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The automobile increased personal mobility, allowing people to commute long distances and making geographical boundaries between work and residence more flexible, thus reshaping urban development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The automobile increased personal mobility, allowing people to commute long distances and making geographical boundaries between work and residence more flexible, thus reshaping urban development.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Modern transport systems enhanced global connectivity by allowing goods and people to move rapidly, which streamlined global trade and fostered international economic and cultural exchange.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Modern transport systems enhanced global connectivity by allowing goods and people to move rapidly, which streamlined global trade and fostered international economic and cultural exchange.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: The essay will focus on the transformative impact of the car on modern society, highlighting its role in urban development, connectivity, and daily life.
outline: Introduction: Introduce the car as a revolutionary transportation vehicle and its significance in changing people's lives.
Body 1: Discuss how the car revolutionized personal mobility and urban development.
Body 2: Explore the socio-economic impact of car ownership and its influence on daily life.
Conclusion: Summarize the car's impact and reflect on its continued influence in the modern world.
keyArguments: The car has revolutionized personal mobility, enabling greater freedom and flexibility in travel.
Urban development has been significantly influenced by the car, leading to the growth of suburbs and infrastructure changes.

plan.focus: The essay will focus on the transformative impact of the car on modern society, highlighting its role in urban development, connectivity, and daily life.
outline: Introduction: Introduce the car as a revolutionary transportation vehicle and its significance in changing people's lives.
Body 1: Discuss how the car revolutionized personal mobility and urban development.
Body 2: Explore the socio-economic impact of car ownership and its influence on daily life.
Conclusion: Summarize the car's impact and reflect on its continued influence in the modern world.
keyArguments: The car has revolutionized personal mobility, enabling greater freedom and flexibility in travel.
Urban development has been significantly influenced by the car, leading to the growth of suburbs and infrastructure changes.
